About This Site
The GIS Website is a result of the combined efforts from Adams County, the City of Hastings, and Hastings Utilities. All data is equally shared by each entity to provide public use of assessor, utility and topographic data. Each entity has the right to determine what information is to be displayed on the site. All data is updated on the first business day of every month when deemed necessary by each entity. For technical support please email our GIS Team .
